args.title: Warehouse returns tote handling
args.description: Open the hinged lid of a tote, place a small carton and a flat pack inside, then close the lid.

steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it upward to open the tote.
Pick the small carton from the bench and place it inside the tote.
Pick the flat pack from the bench and place it inside the tote.
Push the lid down until the tote is closed.

assumptions: The tote interior height is 120 mm, sufficient for the 60 mm carton and 20 mm pack stacked.

args.title: Pipe coupling tightening
args.description: Insert a threaded coupling onto a pipe stub and tighten it to a snug condition without exceeding 8 N m torque.

steps.description: Push the coupling onto the thread start.
Turn the coupling clockwise until snug, limiting torque to 8 N m.

assumptions: Coupling outer diameter ~40 mm, length ~45 mm, thread pitch ~1.5 mm.

insert_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.
tighten_coupling: Threads are an approximation: a helical joint with a torque ramp; no thread flanks, cross-threading or galling. A screen, not a promise.

args.title: Cabinet maintenance
args.description: Unlock the quarter-turn latch, swing the cabinet door open, open the handwheel valve 90 degrees, then insert the test plug into the service port.

steps.description: Turn the latch head counter‑clockwise to unlock it.
Hook the door handle and pull the door open.
Turn the valve wheel counter‑clockwise to open it 90 degrees.
Insert the test plug into the service port until seated.

assumptions: Typical latch needs ~0.8 Nm to overcome detent.
Door hinge resistance ~0.3 Nm, handle clearance 20 mm.
Valve requires ~2 Nm to turn, 90 deg travel for quarter turn.
Port plug diameter 5 mm, insertion force ~5 N, socket depth 10 mm.

unlock_latch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Plant maintenance round
args.description: Open the meter box hatch, turn the isolation valve handwheel one full turn counter‑clockwise, then close the hatch.

steps.description: Hook the hatch handle and pull to open the hatch.
Turn the isolation valve handwheel one full turn counter‑clockwise.
Push the hatch lid to close it.

assumptions: The hatch behaves as a lid with a handle that can be hooked.
The valve requires about 4 N m to turn and allows at least one full revolution.

turn_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: T-shirt folding
args.description: Take a T-shirt from the laundry pile, fold it in thirds on the table and put it in the box.
assumptions: The storage box is 300 x 200 x 120 mm with 4 mm walls and fixed to the table.

unsupported.what: Picking up a T-shirt from the laundry pile
unsupported.reason: Cloth deformation and flexibility are not simulated

unsupported.what: Folding the T-shirt in thirds on the table
unsupported.reason: Cloth folding involves continuous deformation and plasticity, not supported

args.refusal: The core actions involve manipulating cloth (a T-shirt), which includes deformation, folding, and picking up flexible material; these are not supported by the simulator.

Valve requires ~2 Nm to turn, 90 deg travel for quarter turn.
Port plug diameter 5 mm, insertion force ~5 N, socket depth 10 mm.

unlock_latch: Latches are an approximation: a detent torque on a revolute joint; no cam or spring geometry.
open_valve: Valves are an approximation: a resistive torque curve on a revolute joint; no packing or seat dynamics.

args.title: Warehouse returns tote handling
args.description: Open the hinged lid of a tote, place a small carton and a flat pack inside, then close the lid.

steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it upward to open the tote.
Pick the small carton from the bench and place it inside the tote.
Pick the flat pack from the bench and place it inside the tote.
Push the lid down until the tote is closed.

assumptions: The tote interior height is 120 mm, sufficient for the 60 mm carton and 20 mm pack stacked.
